text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is seeking approval to amend the existing two-way operation on Baldwin Street, between Spadina Avenue and a point 98.4 metres west, in order to increase pay-and-display parking, address illegal parking, and enhance driver expectations within this section of roadway.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing one-way westbound traffic operation on Baldwin Street, between Augusta Avenue and a point 98.4 metres west of Spadina Avenue (north intersection). 2. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Baldwin Street, between Spadina Avenue and a point 60.3 metres west. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Baldwin Street, between a point 60.3 metres west of Spadina Avenue and a point 38.3 metres further west. 4. Rescinded the existing parking machine regulation on the south side of Baldwin Street, between a point 98.6 metres west of Spadina Avenue and a point 26 metres further west, operating from 12:00 noon to 9:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, and from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., Saturday and Sunday, for a maximum period of three hours,…
